method: City-first matching against already-built location pages (kakkanad, kalamassery, ernakulam-south, and kalamassery-hitech-park mapped to its resolved winner kalamassery), then service-type matching against already-built service pages for remaining entries. High confidence = clear 1:1 semantic match to an existing page. Medium confidence = plausible but genuinely ambiguous between 2+ reasonable targets — NOT implemented in vercel.json this phase, kept as a documented candidate for future review.
